messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Comparing nonnested models in lavaan
parts:
From the Mrkle and Preacher paper, they presented the Voung test, which is a Likelihood ratio test that allows to test non nested models. The advnatgae is that this has a known distribution from which we can make inferences and test the Null hypothesis, while with AIC and BIC you are more limited.
These features is available in the nonnest2 package https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/nonnest2/index.html
This package has the Vough test, as well as a AIC and BIC confidence interval for the comparison. With these approaches you can compare non-nested models
